supporting_observations.claim: FILE-HD-01 launched the CobaltVault agent as HARBOR-DENTAL\svc-bkp with a Nightly job targeting the approved ingest.cobaltvault.net endpoint.

The nearby proxy records show a successful connection and GET to ingest.cobaltvault.net, but record only a short connection and small client/server byte counts; they do not show a hundreds-of-megabytes transfer.
The CobaltVault process exited at 13:45:58.826 UTC, close to but just before the alert's approximate 13:46 UTC time.
The approved backup agent and destination provide a plausible benign explanation, but the available records do not establish that this process caused the alerted large transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include a flow record identifying the alerted transfer's exact start/end time, destination, byte count, or process attribution.
The nearby proxy records describe a short, low-volume connection and GET, but do not establish what happened in any separate session that generated the alert.
claims_not_established: Whether the alerted hundreds-of-megabytes transfer was to ingest.cobaltvault.net or another destination.
Whether the transfer was generated by cvagent.exe or another process.
What data was transferred and whether its contents and destination were authorized.
Whether the transfer was an expected execution of the Nightly backup job at that time.
additional_evidence_needed: Network-flow or proxy records for the exact alerted session, including destination, timestamps, byte counts, and session identifiers.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for FILE-HD-01 covering the transfer interval.
CobaltVault job and upload logs, including job schedule, completion status, and transferred volume.
unrelated_findings: FILE-HD-01 made proxy requests identifying GlobalProtect and Zscaler client user agents; these services are not listed among approved software/services. Review separately; these records do not establish attribution to the alerted transfer. (T010-00123, T010-00234, T010-00271, T010-00277)

FILE-HD-01 made a proxy connection to downloads.cloud.com with a curl user agent, which is not among the listed approved services. Review separately; this activity is outside the alerted transfer evidence. (T010-00515, T010-00516)
